notes.title: Tactical Battles – Massive Update: New Skills, Recap Battles & More!
notes.content: [p]The battlefield just got better! This new update for [i]Tactical Battles[/i] brings powerful new skills with varying ranges to master, a [b]Recap Battle[/b] screen so you can review your strategies after each fight, and improved controls with a brand-new camera rotation input. Plus, several bug fixes to keep the action smooth and immersive. Sharpen your tactics and dominate the battlefield—wishlist [i]Tactical Battles[/i] on Steam today![/p]

notes.title: Limitless Fury & New Encounters!
notes.content:
This update unleashes a massive new core system: extra attacks you can farm infinitely! On top of that, we’ve added new skills, world content, animations, and major optimizations to take your gameplay to the next level.

🌟 Main Feature

🗡️ Infinite Extra Attacks – Build up and stack extra attacks endlessly. The more you play, the stronger you become!

🧠 New Mechanics & Content

💘 Charm Status – Turn enemies against each other with the new charm effect.

🛡️ Rescue Quest – Help a vulnerable NPC under attack. Succeed to earn rewards!

🎮 Minigame NPC – Meet a character who challenges you to a mini-game. Win for prizes!

🏞️ New Environmental Styles – Fresh visuals and scenery across different maps.

⚔️ New Class Skills

🩸 Blood Mage: Give Blood – Sacrifice HP to empower your magic.

⏳ Time Mage: Slow Attack – Delay enemy turns with temporal disruption.

🌧️ Crossbow Hunter: Rain Arrow – Rains down a flurry of arrows.

🛢️ Robot MK2: Change Oil Attack – Create slippery surfaces for chaos.

🪨 Rack Nature: Boulder Attack – Smash enemies with a massive rock.

🐾 Pug Master: Dirt Toss – Blind enemies by throwing dirt in their face.

🔥 Daemon Robot: Overheat – Unleash powerful damage at a fiery cost.

🌿 Twigs Father Nature: Thornsteam – Poison and pierce with a cloud of thorns.

🎨 Visual & Animation Enhancements

✍️ Text Effects Updated – "Damage" and "Block" texts now appear with smooth animations.

📦 Crate Destruction Animation – Breaking decor elements now has satisfying visual feedback.

🛠️ Fixes & Optimization

🐞 Bug Fixes – Many bugs eliminated for better gameplay.

🚀 Performance Optimization – Improved load times and smoother framerate.

Your journey just got deeper, stronger, and more rewarding. Time to grind those extra attacks and explore all the new gameplay waiting for you!

notes.title: More heroes, more skills, and more chaos!
notes.content:
7 New Playable Classes:

Robo MK2 – A high-tech evolution of destruction.

Robo Demon – Embrace the hell power of machines.

Rock Father Nature – Defense meets nature’s raw force.

Twigs Father Nature – A more twigs, crafty variant.

Pug Master – Because tactics need a good boy.

Bow Master – Long-range domination begins here.

9 New Skills & Abilities:

Extended Steal, Upgrade, Flamethrower, Twigs Advance, Earthquake, Hack, Crossbow, Lick Wound, Divine Smity, Dark Veil (Darkness attack) – Each one opens up new tactical combos.

Quality of Life Improvements:

Speed-up icon added.

Mouse hover now displays ability descriptions.

Dialogue skipper lets you jump into the action faster.

New Mechanics:

Darnest Status and Darnestproof Ability – A new status effect and its counter for deeper strategy.

notes.title: Clash of Light and Blood
notes.content:
A new era begins in Tactical Battles! This massive update introduces four powerful new classes that will redefine your tactical strategies:

🛡️ Dark Knight – Harness the shadows and crush your enemies with ruthless power.
🌟 Holy Knight – The beacon of justice, shielding allies while smiting foes.
🩸 Blood Mage – Trade your own vitality to unleash devastating magic.
⏳ Time Mage – Bend time to your will, turning the tide of battle in a flash.

New Abilities:

Critical Blocker: Reduce the risk of deadly critical hits.

ReflexBlock: A chance to automatically block incoming attacks with perfect timing.

New Skills:

DrainBlood: Siphon life from enemies to heal yourself.

SpeedUpAdvance: Boost your team's movement and agility.

SpeedUp: Increase the pace of your actions.

AuroraHalo: Bathe allies in a radiant aura that enhances their power.

⚔️ Class Shrine – Seek out the mystical shrine to change your class mid-game, opening up limitless strategic possibilities.

📖 Story Upgrade – The narrative deepens. Discover new twists in your journey of vengeance, redemption, and heroism.

notes.title: Tactical Battles: Power Up with New NPCs & Quests!
notes.content:
🛡️ New Warrior NPC – Find a skilled warrior who can upgrade your weapons in exchange for mushrooms.

🧪 New Alchemist NPC – Discover a mysterious alchemist hidden in a house who can enhance your skills.

⚔️ New Quest & Battles – Embark on a brand-new quest filled with intense battles and challenges.

📈 Character Upgrades – Your characters can now learn two powerful skills to turn the tide of battle.

🔥 New Abilities & Skills – Unlock fresh tactics and expand your arsenal.

🐞 Bug Fixes – Improved stability and performance for a smoother experience.

🎯 New Drop Items – Discover valuable new items to aid you on your journey.

📖 Expanded Story – Dive deeper into the world of Tactical Battles with new lore and narrative content.

Get ready to power up your squad and face new challenges in Tactical Battles![previewyoutube=w5PNlynGU_A;leftthumb][/previewyoutube]
